parameters.name: RuleConfig
parameters.description:
The new configuration of the protection rule.

> When you upload a new rule configuration, it overwrites the previous configuration.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection rule. You can specify only one rule ID.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The new name of the protection rule.

parameters.name: RuleStatus
parameters.description:
The new status of the protection rule. Valid values:

- **on**: Enables the rule.

- **off**: Disables the rule.
